decisive_finding.title: TWO_OF_THE_FOUR_M2_FIXTURE_STEPS_ARE_ALREADY_GOVERNED_CANONICAL_LOCAL_SQL
decisive_finding.statement: The M2 fixture applied db/prepared/stella_hosted_0000_managed_role_identity_bootstrap.sql — the MANAGED-Supabase identity package — to a LOCAL disposable container. That package by design 'transfers NO ownership and grants NO table privilege' (its header, lines 33-38) and establishes no schema privilege at all. The LOCAL analogue, db/prepared/stella_0001_role_topology_bootstrap.sql, ALREADY contains two of the three ad-hoc GRANTs as committed, governed SQL.

CREATE POLICY resolves role names at DDL time, so a role-pristine cluster fails at the earliest of those units — the identical failure documented in db/prepared/stella_hosted_0000_managed_role_identity_bootstrap.sql header lines 9-13
decisive_finding.conclusion: The LOCAL path carries the SAME ordering conflict that the HOSTED path resolved by the HPO-ODS-W2-03 identity/privilege split, and locally that conflict is UNSOLVED. Resolving it — by introducing a local pre-baseline identity package that references no application table — is the architectural content of P1A. Two of the four M2 'fixture' steps are therefore MOVED into that package, not invented by it.

M2_STEP_3_database_create.rationale: Required by Drizzle's own bookkeeping schema creation, which is a property of the migration tool and not of the fixture. Any clean bootstrap of this corpus needs it. The canonical form is a SCOPED GRANT/REVOKE window around the migration run, not a standing privilege: scripts/m2-disposable-pg-bootstrap.ts:798 already asserts has_database_privilege(owner,'CREATE') == false in the final contract.

M2_STEP_4_public_schema_create.rationale: Not authored anew. Moved verbatim into the pre-baseline package, with stella_0001 converted to ASSERT it rather than re-grant it — the exact split pattern stella_hosted_0000 / stella_hosted_0001 already established, where the successor asserts what the predecessor created.

M2_STEP_5_auth_schema_usage.actor_note: The supabase_admin actor is canonical for BOTH the local Supabase CLI stack and the pinned CI container image, because in neither does the postgres role own schema auth. What is fixture-specific is only the psqlAs mechanism scripts/m2-disposable-pg-bootstrap.ts uses to reach that actor, never the actor itself. The single-privilege-write invariant at scripts/m2-disposable-pg-bootstrap.ts:645-654 is canonical and is inherited as P1A-N7.

M2_STEP_6_part_a_helpers.rationale: db/prepared/storage/20260716000001_part_a_helpers.psql.sql is baseline unit 41 of the 64-unit governed baseline, not a bootstrap artifact. M2 hoists it out of baseline order because migration 0039 needs the two evidence-access functions it creates. The canonical P1A answer is NOT to re-hoist it inside a script: it is to declare it a NAMED ORDERED PHASE (PHASE_PART_A_PREREQUISITE) applied VERBATIM and SHA-verified. The canonical topology has phases; it does not have loose SQL.

responsibilities: create and configure the five governed Uellix roles: uellix_owner, uellix_migrator, uellix_app, uellix_writer, uellix_auditor
establish memberships: uellix_owner TO uellix_migrator WITH INHERIT FALSE, SET TRUE; uellix_writer TO uellix_app WITH INHERIT TRUE, SET FALSE
reference NO application table — this is the property that makes the pre-baseline split possible at all
pristine-state precondition, refusing before any privilege mutation
explicit environment guard with NO default, following the db/prepared/stella_hosted_0000_managed_role_identity_bootstrap.sql:111-117 pattern
self-verification block at the end, asserting attributes, memberships and the absence of any SET path from uellix_app to uellix_owner or uellix_migrator

depend on any RLS helper or baseline migration
add LOGIN to uellix_owner or uellix_writer

permanent_local_topology: GRANT USAGE, CREATE ON SCHEMA public TO uellix_owner
REVOKE CREATE ON SCHEMA public FROM uellix_migrator, uellix_app, uellix_writer, uellix_auditor, PUBLIC
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA auth TO uellix_owner, issued through the legitimate local schema owner/issuer
phases.provenance: The first two are moved verbatim from db/prepared/stella_0001_role_topology_bootstrap.sql:175-177; the third from :181. They are canonical local topology already, not new privilege.
phases.actor_note: The auth-schema grant must be issued by the role that actually owns schema auth on the substrate — supabase_admin on both the Supabase CLI local stack and the pinned CI image. The postgres role does not own it. This is the ONE governed privilege write performed under that actor, and the single-write invariant is P1A-N7.

phases.application: Applied as uellix_migrator with SET ROLE uellix_owner active, in ONE continuous session, SHA-verified before every application, with a fail-closed assertion that SET ROLE actually took effect before the file's own statements run.
phases.why_a_named_phase: It is baseline unit 41, needed by migration 0039. Treating it as a named ordered phase rather than ad-hoc copied SQL is the difference between a governed topology and a fixture. The gate copies nothing: it reads the committed file and executes it verbatim.
phases.postcondition: Both public.can_read_evidence_object and public.can_write_evidence_object exist and are owned by uellix_owner — the existing PRIV-P7 check, inherited as P1A-P5.

sequence: GRANT CREATE ON DATABASE <disposable-db> TO uellix_owner  — TEMPORARY
credential rotation via the unmodified scripts/rotate-local-role-credentials.ts, inside one bounded credential window
pnpm db:migrate:local — the canonical, UNMODIFIED entry point
REVOKE CREATE ON DATABASE <disposable-db> FROM uellix_owner — ALWAYS, on every path
phases.always_means: The REVOKE is unconditional: it runs on success, on ordinary failure, and on a thrown exception. A path that can skip it is a defect, not an optimisation.
phases.credential_window_is_single: Rotation, migration, the corpus proof, the privilege and ownership postconditions and any test that reads the rotated credentials must all sit INSIDE one restoration window. Restoring env files immediately after migrate() and before the tests leaves the tests on pre-rotation credentials and fails with a password-authentication error — measured and documented at scripts/m2-disposable-pg-bootstrap.ts:857-864.
phases.migrator_narrowing_precondition: uellix_migrator must hold NOCREATEROLE, NOSUPERUSER and NOBYPASSRLS before migration, and the narrowing must survive credential rotation. Existing controls: scripts/m2-disposable-pg-bootstrap.ts:617-626 and the NARROWING-SURVIVES-ROTATION check.

phases.env_dependency_disposition: scripts/stella-r3-4-local-runner.ts:24,45-48 requires UELLIX_LOCAL_ADMIN_DATABASE_URL for its fixed administrative phases. If the future gate exercises this phase, it MUST supply that variable deterministically from its OWN disposable environment, for the duration of the run only. It must NOT become a preexisting host env dependency, and it must NOT be read from an operator's shell or a CI secret. If supplying it deterministically proves impossible without editing scripts/stella-r3-4-local-runner.ts, that is a STOP_FOR_AUTHORITY_DELTA, because that file is not in the authorized surface.
phases.may_be_out_of_minimum_invariant: This phase is NOT part of the minimum gate invariant. The successor mission may exercise it or may explicitly declare it out of the gate's scope with a recorded reason. What it may not do is depend on a host-provided value.

stella_0001_successor_contract.assertion_semantics: The assertions must FAIL CLOSED: if the pre-baseline package did not establish the privilege, stella_0001 must raise, never silently continue and never re-grant as a fallback. A fallback grant would recreate exactly the ambiguity this split exists to remove.
stella_0001_successor_contract.no_silent_cleanup_or_refactor: No reformatting, no comment rewriting beyond what the two converted blocks require, no reordering of sections, no incidental tidying of neighbouring statements.
stella_0001_successor_contract.additional_change_rule: Any further change to this file requires an EXACT mechanical dependency, explicitly enumerated in the successor mission's evidence artifact with the failing command that establishes the necessity. Absent that, it is an unauthorized delta.
stella_0001_successor_contract.preserved_invariants: stella_0001's own verification blocks — notably the assertions at :301 (uellix_app has no SET path to uellix_owner), :307 (app/migrator/auditor hold no effective CREATE on public), :328 (no PUBLIC CREATE grant on public) and :335 (no Uellix role granted access to auth.users) — must all continue to pass unchanged after the conversion.

second_run_contract.gate_meaning: Each full pnpm p1a:bootstrap:gate invocation creates a fresh disposable environment and tears it down unconditionally. Two consecutive invocations both succeed.
second_run_contract.causal_invariant: It must be idempotent BECAUSE it provisions a fresh environment each time, never because it detects and tolerates residue. A second run that passes by REUSING state is a contract FAILURE even if every check reports green. The successor mission must be able to point at the mechanism, not merely at the green result.
second_run_contract.rejection_point: The pristine-role precondition, BEFORE any privilege mutation. Existing mechanism: checkPristineRoles in scripts/m2-disposable-pg-bootstrap.ts:598-602 requires exactly zero roles matching uellix\_% .
second_run_contract.rejection_semantics: Non-zero exit, zero mutation, env files untouched, and a diagnostic naming the residue found.
second_run_contract.explicitly_not_idempotent_convergence: The bootstrap is NOT authorized to be 'idempotent with respect to its own end state'. The repository's own evidence is db/prepared/README.md, which documents that grounding_0003 re-applied alone silently reverts grounding_0004's two security repairs while its own self-verification still passes: a missing GRANT raises, a missing POLICY is silent. Convergence-style idempotence is therefore forbidden here by measured precedent, not by preference.

fresh_machine_requires_no_preexisting_en.measured_basis: scripts/rotate-local-role-credentials.ts requires no env file: db/safety/resolve-local-database-url.ts:86 falls back to the pinned LOCAL_DATABASE_URL constant. The rotation script contains no existsSync precondition on any env file. It WRITES all three (scripts/rotate-local-role-credentials.ts:70-89 and :264-266) and removes the legacy DATABASE_URL from .env.local (:275-278).
fresh_machine_requires_no_preexisting_en.consequence: .env.migration.local is a PRODUCT of the canonical path, never a precondition of it. Blocker A is an ORDERING constraint, not a design constraint, and the canonical order — bootstrap roles, rotate, migrate — satisfies it by construction.

env_lifecycle_contract.no_new_env_precondition: The successor mission may not introduce any new environment-variable or env-file precondition on the host. See canonical_topology phase 6 for the UELLIX_LOCAL_ADMIN_DATABASE_URL disposition.

exact_restoration.existing_file: restored byte-identical, verified by sha256 comparison against the pre-run snapshot
exact_restoration.initially_absent_file: absent after the gate — deleted, not left behind
exact_restoration.never_printed: No env file content and no credential may be printed, logged or included in any diagnostic. Evidence is limited to truncated digests.

R2_F2_closure_requirement.measured_gap_at_base: installSignalCleanup in scripts/m2-disposable-pg-bootstrap.ts:317-334 performs container removal ONLY and then calls process.exit(130). It does not call restoreEnvFiles, and process.exit does not run the pending finally block of the suspended async frame. A SIGTERM arriving between rotation and window close therefore leaves rotated credentials on disk at this node's base.
required_of_successor: maintain a live registry of the active env snapshot, analogous to the existing activeContainers set
attempt EXACT restoration (same bytes, or same absence, sha256-verified) from the SIGINT and SIGTERM handlers, before process exit
record the signal-path restoration as its own check id with its own verdict
declare EXCEPTION_SAFE=YES for in-process throws, SIGINT_SIGTERM_RESTORE=BEST_EFFORT_USERLAND, and HARD_PROCESS_TERMINATION_GUARANTEE=NO
never claim restoration under SIGKILL or host loss
R2_F2_closure_requirement.control_must_be_real: P1A-N5 must deliver a REAL signal to a REAL process and observe the resulting on-disk state. A mocked handler, a label-only assertion, or a test that merely checks a handler was registered is VACUOUS and does not satisfy this requirement.

p1a_machine_gate.workflow_model: .github/workflows/m2-real-pg-gate.yml — same shape: checkout, pnpm setup, node setup, frozen-lockfile install, one gate command.
target_invariant: fresh disposable PostgreSQL / Supabase-compatible substrate, own container, port proven free, no spurious mounts
semantic readiness, not a bare port probe
canonical local identity bootstrap from a governed artifact

p1a_machine_gate.cheap_controls_first: Every no-Docker self-control must run and be green BEFORE any container starts, following the existing precedent at scripts/m2-disposable-pg-bootstrap.ts:1071-1078. A broken parser or proof helper must never be discovered only after minutes of container work.
p1a_machine_gate.migration_corpus_derivation: Mechanically from db/migrations/meta/_journal.json entries plus sha256 of each named .sql file, matching drizzle-orm's own readMigrationFiles, compared against the hash column of drizzle.__drizzle_migrations in application order. Never a hardcoded count and never a prose claim. Reuse deriveExpectedMigrationCorpus / evaluateMigrationProof / checkMigrationProof.

m2_reuse_decision.authorized_modification_scope: ONLY adding the export keyword to existing pure or reusable helpers that P1A requires. Nothing else.
m2_reuse_decision.measured_necessity: The reusable helpers in that file are module-scoped and not exported; the file is a script guarded by an invokedDirectly check at :1095. Importing them therefore requires widening their visibility. This is the smallest change that achieves reuse without relocation.
explicitly_forbidden: relocation of any helper to another file
any change to an M2 check id
any change to the M2 expected check count

creating scripts/lib/** or any other shared-library path
m2_reuse_decision.required_regression_control: A control proving pnpm m2:pg:gate continues to produce the governed PASS semantics unchanged after export widening: the set of recorded check ids and the total check count must be identical to the pre-change baseline. This is control P1A-M1 in the test manifest.
m2_reuse_decision.escalation: If simple export widening proves technically impossible, STOP_FOR_AUTHORITY_DELTA. The successor mission may NOT silently choose EXTRACT_SHARED.

positive_controls.P1A-P1: Semantic platform readiness: a fresh disposable container reaches auth, storage and extensions present with a resolvable auth.uid(), proven by two consecutive successful samples, within a bounded poll that terminates.
positive_controls.P1A-P2: Zero preexisting roles matching uellix\_% before bootstrap.
positive_controls.P1A-P3: The local identity package is applied verbatim and its pinned sha256 is verified before application; its own self-verification block passes.
positive_controls.P1A-P4: Pre-migration privilege contract: owner has database CREATE, public USAGE and CREATE, auth USAGE; migrator has no CREATEROLE, no SUPERUSER, no BYPASSRLS; the owner membership is set_option=true with inherit_option=false.
positive_controls.P1A-P5: Both Part-A helper functions exist and are owned by uellix_owner.
positive_controls.P1A-P6: Credential rotation succeeds starting from NO preexisting env files, mints three distinct secrets, and real role possession is verified by opening an actual connection with each minted credential and confirming session_user equals the expected role. No credential is printed.
positive_controls.P1A-P7: pnpm db:migrate:local exits 0, and the mechanically derived corpus proof passes on all three sub-checks: count equals the journal-derived count, the hash sequence matches in application order, and the terminal 0061 hash is present.
positive_controls.P1A-P8: Ownership postcondition: zero application objects in public or drizzle owned by anything other than uellix_owner; and the final privilege contract passes with database CREATE proven revoked.
positive_controls.P1A-P9: B0 and security postconditions pass against real disposable PostgreSQL state, exercised through the real check path rather than synthetic fixtures.
positive_controls.P1A-P10: Unconditional teardown, zero labelled leftover containers, and exact env restoration — existing files byte-identical, initially absent files absent.

inherited_by_reference.note: Semantically identical existing M2 controls are inherited BY REFERENCE, not duplicated. The successor mission re-points their construction path at the canonical local package and preserves the pattern and the check-id shape.
inherited_by_reference.PRIV-N1a: scripts/m2-disposable-pg-bootstrap.ts:937-938 — STEP 3 omitted entirely; the gap is proven absent by direct SQL before the migration is proven to refuse
inherited_by_reference.PRIV-N2: scripts/m2-disposable-pg-bootstrap.ts:952-956 — database CREATE granted to uellix_migrator only, never to uellix_owner; SET ROLE uellix_owner still lacks it
inherited_by_reference.PRIV-N3: scripts/m2-disposable-pg-bootstrap.ts:958-982 — a deliberate extra privilege must be CAUGHT by the final contract probe
inherited_by_reference.PRIV-N4: scripts/m2-disposable-pg-bootstrap.ts:984-1015 — CREATEROLE re-granted to uellix_migrator before migration must be refused
inherited_by_reference.PRIV-N5: scripts/m2-disposable-pg-bootstrap.ts:1017-1019 — migration credential pointed at the superuser instead of uellix_migrator must be refused
inherited_by_reference.non_vacuity_pattern: Each control's real proof is a direct SQL query confirming the specific privilege gap is absent, deterministic and independent of error-message text, PLUS a non-zero exit from the migration entry point. Pattern-matching a diagnostic string is not acceptable, because scripts/db-migrate-local.ts does not guarantee the underlying PostgreSQL error text reaches its output.

negative_controls.P1A-N1: With NO preexisting .env.local, .env.migration.local or .env.audit.local — verified absent by the snapshot recording existed=false for all three — the canonical full path still succeeds end to end, and final restoration leaves all three ABSENT.
negative_controls.P1A-N2: Wrong migration session role is REJECTED with ZERO migration advancement: the credential is pointed at the superuser, the entry point exits non-zero, and drizzle.__drizzle_migrations gains no row. The row-count assertion is mandatory — a non-zero exit alone does not prove nothing advanced.
negative_controls.P1A-N3: SET ROLE ineffective is REJECTED and leaves NO incorrect ownership: the owner membership or its set_option is removed before migrating, the entry point fails with the set-role diagnostic, and a direct query proves no object was created owned by anything other than uellix_owner.
negative_controls.P1A-N4: Journal and corpus mutation is REJECTED, on TWO distinct vectors: (a) terminal entry removed — all three sub-checks fail; (b) SAME CARDINALITY but two hashes reordered — the count check passes while the corpus-order check FAILS. Vector (b) does not exist at this node's base and is what proves the verification is order-sensitive rather than merely cardinality-sensitive. Both mutations must be disposable and in-memory; neither may write to db/migrations/** .
negative_controls.P1A-N5: A REAL SIGTERM delivered to a REAL gate process during the credential window results in best-effort EXACT env restoration: after exit, all three files match their pre-run bytes or pre-run absence, sha256-verified. Mocked or label-only is vacuous and does not satisfy this control.
negative_controls.P1A-N6: Bootstrap repeated against the SAME non-pristine database is deterministically REJECTED BEFORE any privilege write: the second application fails at the pristine-role precondition, and a direct query proves no privilege changed between the two attempts.
negative_controls.P1A-N7: No unauthorized privilege write under supabase_admin outside the one explicitly governed auth-schema capability: a per-container call-count invariant proves exactly one such write per fixture.
negative_controls.non_vacuity_requirement: Every negative control must be non-vacuous: it must be demonstrated that the control FAILS when the guarantee it protects is removed. A control that passes both with and against the guarantee proves nothing and is forbidden.

mutation_controls.P1A-M1: M2 regression: after export widening, pnpm m2:pg:gate produces an identical set of recorded check ids and an identical total check count to its pre-change baseline. A changed id or count is a FAIL, not a rebaseline.
mutation_controls.P1A-M2: Removing the unconditional REVOKE of database CREATE causes the final privilege contract to FAIL — proving the revoke is load-bearing and not decorative.
mutation_controls.P1A-M3: Removing the finally-guaranteed teardown or the finally-guaranteed env restoration causes a control to FAIL — proving both guarantees are enforced rather than merely present.

protected_grant_rationale: The three future db/prepared paths this authority authorizes all match DEFAULT_PROTECTED_PATTERNS' db/prepared/** in scripts/ods-scope.ts (lines 82-90) and are therefore unconditionally protected absent a resolved grant. This authority is the source of that grant, and the registry entry below is its machine-enforced counterpart. The grant authorizes ONLY the exact union of its own literal patterns — never the broader db/prepared/** that made the paths protected in the first place (scripts/ods-scope.ts classifyPaths, lines 107-135). The ordinary --allow list remains ADDITIONALLY mandatory for every granted path: a protected grant does not replace --allow, and neither substitutes for the other. Note that NO db/prepared file is actually changed by THIS mission; the grant is registered in advance so the successor implementation mission cannot claim retroactive authorization.
